header: Enable and disable logging for private managed zones
content:
Use DNS policies to enable or disable logging for your networks. When you enable query
logging, every DNS query to a Cloud DNS private managed zone is logged.
To enable logging for a network that does not have a DNS policy, run the dns policies
create (/sdk/gcloud/reference/dns/policies/create) command.
Replace the following:
POLICY_NAME: the name of the DNS policy
gcloud
(#gcloud)
gcloud dns policies create
\
--networks=
\
--enable-logging \
--description=
POLICY_NAME edit
NETWORK edit
DESCRIPTION edit
NETWORK: one or more networks in a comma-separated list
DESCRIPTION: a description of the policy
To enable logging for a network that has an existing DNS policy, run the dns policies update
(/sdk/gcloud/reference/dns/policies/update) command.
Replace the following:
POLICY_NAME: the name of the DNS policy
NETWORK: one or more networks in a comma-separated list
To turn off logging while leaving the policy in place, run the dns policies update
(/sdk/gcloud/reference/dns/policies/update) command.
Replace the following:
POLICY_NAME: the name of the DNS policy
NETWORK: one or more networks in a comma-separated list
To delete the policy entirely, run the dns policies delete
(/sdk/gcloud/reference/dns/policies/delete) command.
Replace POLICY_NAME with the name of the DNS policy that you want to delete.
